staffGuide.title: Staff guide
staffGuide.intro: Sign in with the staff account from the shop. Choose a topic for the steps and a link to the screen you need.

clock.title: Clock in and out
steps: Scan the QR at the shop with your phone camera. If prompted, sign in with your staff account.
Select “Confirm clock-in” when you arrive. Scan again and select “Confirm clock-out” before leaving. Check the recorded time under “My status”.
Check who has clocked in or out. If the QR expires, scan the code currently on the shop screen.

daily.title: Check appointments and rooms
steps: Select “View today’s work” from Staff home to see appointments you can access and their status.
Use Schedule to look up a different date. Use Rooms to check room availability and status.

treatment.title: Start and finish a treatment
steps: Once the front desk has checked in the guest, open your appointment in Today and select “Start treatment”.
Mark the appointment completed when you finish. After cleaning the room, mark it ready. Use the room issue button if something needs attention.

desk.title: Book and check in guests
steps: Create a new booking in Schedule and pick the guest, service, therapist, room and time. For a guest who is already at the shop, choose the walk-in option.
When the guest arrives, open the confirmed appointment in Today and check them in so the therapist can start treatment.
If your account can record payments, use the pending payments section to record the amount and payment method after receiving the payment.

sick.title: Report sick leave
steps: Enter your first and last day of leave. For one day, use the same date in both fields, then send the request.
Check the decision in Request history. You can withdraw a request that is still pending and submit a corrected one.

shifts.title: Request next month’s shifts
steps: Pick the days you can work. Select several days together if they use the same hours.
Enter the start and end times and send the request. Submit a separate request for days with different hours. An end time earlier than the start ends on the following day.
Check the decision in Request history. Approved requests for accounts linked to therapist profiles are added to the shop’s therapist roster.

management.title: Display the QR and review requests
steps: Select “Open the shop time clock QR” from Staff home and leave it on the shop screen. The code updates automatically.
Open Review staff requests and check dates and times before approving. If sick leave affects appointments, open Today to reassign them.

account.title: Manage your account
steps: Open My account to check your role or change your password. Contact your manager or the owner if you can’t sign in.
Sign out when you finish using a shared device.

metrics.booked: Booked revenue: for bookings whose service starts in the period, the discounted price of completed bookings plus the fee on cancelled and no-show bookings. A rescheduled booking is one booking, counted on the day it finally starts.
metrics.collected: Collected revenue: payments received in the period, not counting voided ones. Money still awaiting verification is included here and shown separately under Payments.
metrics.refunded: Refunded: refunds recorded in the period, not counting voided ones.
metrics.net: Net collected: collected revenue minus refunds.
metrics.avgTransaction: Average transaction value: booked revenue of completed bookings divided by the number of completed bookings (fees excluded).
metrics.cancellationRate: Cancellation rate: cancelled bookings divided by all bookings starting in the period.
metrics.noShowRate: No-show rate: no-show bookings divided by all bookings starting in the period.
metrics.reschedules: Bookings: all bookings starting in the period, whatever their status. Reschedules are counted from the booking history, and a moved booking is still one booking.
metrics.returningRate: Returning customer rate: of customers with a completed booking in the period, the share who had a completed booking before their first one in the period.
metrics.roomUtilization: Room utilisation: booked room minutes divided by open minutes, less maintenance or closed blocks on that room. Open minutes are the minutes covered by at least one rostered therapist shift. Turnover: the average minutes from start to ready and the share marked ready on time.
metrics.therapistUtilization: Therapist utilisation: booked minutes divided by shift minutes, less time off inside shifts.
metrics.turnover: Turnover efficiency: for turnovers started in the period, the average minutes from start to ready and the share marked ready by the due time.
metrics.peaks: Peak periods: bookings that are not cancelled or no-show, by weekday and by hour of the start time (Bangkok time).
metrics.byService: Revenue by service: completed bookings only, discounted price, fees not attributed. Retired services still appear when they have completed bookings in the period.
metrics.byTherapist: Revenue by therapist: completed bookings only, discounted price, fees not attributed. Therapists who left still appear when they have completed bookings in the period.
metrics.openMinutes: Open minutes: the minutes in the period covered by at least one therapist shift.

adminGuide.intro: Use these steps to set up the spa and manage each appointment from booking to checkout.

setup.title: Set up rooms, services and therapists
setup.body: Set up room categories and rooms first. Add each service with its price, duration and eligible room categories. In Therapists, set which services each therapist offers and add their shifts.

booking.title: Create or move a booking
booking.body: In Schedule, choose the date and select New booking. Select the guest, service, therapist, time and an available room. To move an appointment, open the booking, choose Move, then confirm the new time.

visit.title: Check in guests and turn over rooms
visit.body: Open the appointment in Today. Check in the guest when they arrive, start the treatment when it begins and mark it complete when it ends. In Rooms, mark the room ready after cleaning.

guests.title: Manage guests and the waitlist
guests.body: Find the guest by name or phone number. Open their profile to see visit history and update treatment preferences. Open Waitlist from Guests to review requests or cancel a request.

payments.title: Record and reconcile payments
payments.body: Open the appointment and record the amount and payment method after receiving payment. In Payments, select the date and compare the recorded totals by method with the amounts received.

stock.title: Track inventory and settle commissions
stock.body: In Inventory, add materials, record receipts and set the quantity each service uses. In Commissions, set rates, review the closing preview for the period and approve it. Record each payout after sending it.

owner.title: Manage access and spa policies
owner.body: In Staff, invite team members and assign their roles. In Policies, review booking limits, cancellation and no-show fees, and access to reports.

business.earningsSubtitle: Review completed treatment commissions and set rates by service or therapist
business.earningsHelp: Accruals for treatments completed after this feature was added, not payroll paid. The basis is the service price after discounts and refunds, excluding fees. Fixed commissions reduce proportionally with refunds. Rates are captured at completion; later rule edits do not change them. No rule means zero commission. Earlier reports can change when later discounts or refunds are recorded.
business.rulesHelp: Set a rate for a service. A therapist-specific rate overrides its general rate. Save the same service and therapist to update a rule. Changes apply only to subsequent completions.
business.latestRows: Showing {shown} of {total} latest entries. Summary totals include all entries in this period.
business.inventorySubtitle: Receive supplies, review balances, and set materials used per treatment
business.inventoryHelp: Balances show current stock; history and material usage costs use the selected dates. Materials are deducted at treatment completion using the average cost captured at that time. Only completions after this feature was added are included. Negative stock is flagged without preventing treatment completion. Service refunds do not automatically return consumed materials.
business.movementHelp: Receipts update the weighted average cost. Always use the material unit. Adjust by the quantity added or removed, e.g. -2 to remove two units. Adjustments keep the existing average cost and require a reason.
business.recipeHelp: Set materials and quantities for one treatment. Completion deducts them exactly once. Recipe edits affect subsequent completions only. Save an empty recipe to clear it. Inactive materials remain consumed by existing recipes until removed.
business.invalidPeriod: Choose valid dates, with the end on or after the start and no more than 366 days apart.
business.loadFailed: Could not load data. Check the connection and database update, then try again.
business.costByServiceHelp: Actual material deductions in this period, averaged only over treatments with material usage. Excludes labor, rent and other expenses.

care.staffWaitlistHelp: Up to 200 active requests, oldest first. The scheduled dispatcher checks availability and offers times automatically. Offers may expire before the next screen refresh.
care.settlementHelp: Approval freezes the difference from earlier approved commissions. Later refunds or discounts appear as a new positive or negative adjustment. Recording a payout acknowledges a payment or adjustment made outside this system; it does not transfer money.
